name: Country
definition: 具有明确地理边界与主权属性的政治实体，是联赛与比赛举办地的上位归属单元。 Counterexample: 与'地区/城市'混淆：后者是主权实体内部的次级行政单元，不具备主权属性。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Country; provenance: direct source Country

name: League
definition: 由特定国家或地区组织、按赛季周期性举办并由多支球队参加的竞技赛事组织。 Counterexample: 与'杯赛/锦标赛'混淆：后者多为淘汰制短期赛事，而联赛通常为循环积分制跨赛季进行。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table League; provenance: direct source League

name: Match
definition: 在特定日期于特定联赛中由两支球队对阵并产生比分结果的竞技事件。 Counterexample: 与'赛季/阶段'混淆：后者是比赛的时间组织单元，本身不产生比分结果。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Match; provenance: direct source Match

name: Player
definition: 以个人身份注册并参加足球竞技比赛的自然人运动员。 Counterexample: 与'球队职员/教练'混淆：后者不以上场参赛为身份特征。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player; provenance: direct source Player

name: Player_Attributes
definition: 在某一日期对某名球员各项竞技能力进行量化评估后形成的信息记录。 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：后者是自然人实体，前者是对该实体在特定时点的能力评估信息。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player_Attributes; provenance: direct source Player_Attributes

name: Team
definition: 由多名球员组成、以集体身份参加联赛与比赛的竞技组织。 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：后者是自然人个体，前者是由个体组成的集体组织。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team; provenance: direct source Team

name: Team_Attributes
definition: 在某一日期对某支球队战术风格与攻防特征进行量化评估后形成的信息记录。 Counterexample: 与'球队'混淆：后者是竞技组织实体，前者是对该组织在特定时点的战术评估信息。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team_Attributes; provenance: direct source Team_Attributes

name: HomeTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the home team in a match.

name: AwayTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the away team in a match.

name: Season
definition: The football season label in which a match was played.

name: CountryName
definition: Name of the country associated with a league or match.

name: LeagueName
definition: Name of the football league.

name: MatchDate
definition: Date on which a match was played.

name: BuildUpPlaySpeed
definition: Team attribute measuring the speed at which attacks are built up.
aliases: speed in which attacks are put together

name: OverallRating
definition: Player's overall ability rating.

name: Potential
definition: Player's potential ability rating.

name: PreferredFoot
definition: Player's preferred foot for playing.
aliases: prefer to use the right foot

name: PlayerHeight
definition: Player's height in centimeters.

name: HeadingAccuracy
definition: Player attribute measuring accuracy of headers.

name: LongShots
definition: Player attribute measuring ability to shoot from long distance.

name: Jumping
definition: Player attribute measuring jumping ability.

name: Finishing
definition: Player attribute measuring finishing ability.

name: Curve
definition: Player attribute measuring curve on shots.

name: Weight
definition: Player's weight.

name: ChanceCreationPassing
definition: Team attribute measuring chance creation through passing.

name: ChanceCreationPassingClass
definition: Classification label for chance creation passing score.

name: Crossing
definition: Player attribute measuring crossing ability.

name: Birthday
definition: Player's date of birth.

name: SprintSpeed
definition: Player attribute measuring sprint speed.

name: PlayerName
definition: Full name of the player.

name: TeamName
definition: Long name of the team.

name: DrawMatch
definition: Match where home and away goals are equal.

name: AverageHomeGoals
definition: Average number of home goals per match. Formula: SUM(HomeTeamGoals) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id). Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = Match.home_team_goal

name: AverageHeadingAccuracy
definition: Average heading accuracy per player. Formula: SUM(HeadingAccuracy) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id). Inputs: HeadingAccuracy = Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy

name: AverageLongShots
definition: Average long shots per player. Formula: SUM(LongShots) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id). Inputs: LongShots = Player_Attributes.long_shots

name: PercentageUnder180WithHighRating
definition: Percentage of players under 180 cm with overall rating above 70. Formula: COUNT(PlayerHeight < 180 AND OverallRating > 70) / COUNT(id) * 100. Inputs: PlayerHeight = Player.height WHERE height > 180; OverallRating = Player_Attributes.overall_rating
aliases: percentage of players under 180 cm with overall strength > 7

name: PercentageLeftFoot
definition: Percentage of players preferring left foot. Formula: SUM(PreferredFoot = 'left') * 100 / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id). Inputs: PreferredFoot = Player_Attributes.preferred_foot WHERE preferred_foot IN ('left','right')
aliases: percentage of players who prefer left foot

name: PlayerAge
definition: Current age of player computed from birthday. Formula: DATETIME() - Birthday. Inputs: Birthday = Player.birthday

name: JumpingDifference
definition: Difference in jumping scores between two players. Formula: Jumping(player1) - Jumping(player2). Inputs: Jumping = Player_Attributes.jumping

name: DrawMatchCount
definition: Count of matches ending as draw. Formula: COUNT(DrawMatch). Inputs: DrawMatch = Match.home_team_goal WHERE home_team_goal = away_team_goal
